_meta.description: Equine performance standards library — 40 breeds, individual animal tracking
_meta.entry_frequency_note: daily for racing breeds, weekly for all others

official_research: thoroughbred (Pagan et al. 2008 — 9,589 observations Kentucky TB farms)

fields.foal_id: horse_id of resulting foal — links to new horse record

_meta.nrc_2007_equation: BW = MBW * pct_table[age_months]; pct from NRC 2007 pooled breed data

workload_definitions.maintenance: No imposed exercise — pasture or light turnout only
workload_definitions.light: 1-3 hrs/week light work — trail riding, leisure
workload_definitions.moderate: 3-5 hrs/week moderate work — dressage, jumping, ranch
workload_definitions.heavy: 4-5 hrs/week intense work — racing, eventing, polo
workload_definitions.very_heavy: Competition peak — racing, elite eventing, endurance racing

_meta.bcs_scale: Henneke 1-9 scale. Target 4-6 for most horses. 5 = ideal.

_meta.name: Thoroughbred
_meta.data_source: Kentucky TB farms (Pagan et al. 2008) — 9,589 observations birth–18mo; NRC 2007 fallback 18mo+

pregnant_early.note: Same as maintenance — minimal extra requirements months 1-8

pregnant_late.note: 12% increase in DE over maintenance — NRC 2007

lactating_early.note: 70% increase in DE — peak lactation NRC 2007

lactating_late.note: 45% increase in DE — declining milk production NRC 2007
